title: fix(app-shell): supply the spec-declared ctx.org scope in the console action runtime (objectui#10918)
body:
Fixes #10918
Clause-②: no

## What changed

The spec-declared `org` key is now in both console action contexts that lacked it:

- `useConsoleActionRuntime` publishes the active organization under `org` in `actionProviderProps.context`. Before this change it published it only under the undeclared key `activeOrganization`, which is kept unchanged.
- `RecordDetailView`'s own `ActionProvider` shadows the shell runtime for every record-page action. It now carries `org` next to the unchanged `record`, `objectName` and `user`. No other key is added.
- Both call one helper, `actionContextOrg` in `packages/app-shell/src/utils/actionContextOrg.ts`. It returns `id`, `slug` and `name`, or `null` with no active organization. It is not exported from the package entry, and no exported type, entry export or published accept set changes.

## Why

`@objectstack/spec` `ui/action.zod.ts` declares `${ctx.org.id}` in the `ActionSchema.target` interpolation doc ("`ctx.recordId`, `ctx.user.id`, `ctx.org.id`, etc."). The `onSuccess` block lists the scope as "`ctx.user.*`, `ctx.org.*`, `ctx.recordId`, `ctx.selection`".

`ActionRunner.buildInterpolationContext` builds `org` from `context.org` (falling back to `context.organization`, then an empty object). The console runtime supplied neither key, so `${ctx.org.id}` interpolated to an empty string. Cloud's welcome-page "invite members" CTA needs `/apps/cloud_control/sys_organization/record/${ctx.org.id}`.

Scope: the fix covers every console surface that mounts an action provider. That is `ConsoleShell`'s root provider, `ObjectView`, `PageView` (via `ConsoleActionRuntimeProvider`), `DeclaredActionsBar`, and the record page's own provider in `RecordDetailView`.

## Premise re-verified on `origin/main` (`af2221d`)

- The provider context in `useConsoleActionRuntime` carried `activeOrganization` and no `org`.
- `ActionRunner.buildInterpolationContext` reads `this.context.org ?? this.context.organization ?? {}`.
- The new test failed on the unfixed tree with `Expected: "/apps/cloud_control/sys_organization/record/org_acme"` / `Received: "/apps/cloud_control/sys_organization/record/"`.
- The record page's own `ActionProvider` context in `RecordDetailView` carried `record`, `objectName` and `user` and no `org`. With the first commit in place, `${ctx.org.id}` still resolved empty there.

## Tests (all at `44de8b6`, after merging `origin/main` `7e8b3c0`)

Two pins. Each drives a `type: 'url'` action targeting `/apps/cloud_control/sys_organization/record/${ctx.org.id}` through a real provider and the real `ActionRunner` interpolation:

- `packages/app-shell/src/hooks/__tests__/useConsoleActionRuntime.ctxOrg-10918.test.tsx` runs through the real `ConsoleActionRuntimeProvider` and asserts the URL handed to the router.
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.ctxOrg-10918.test.tsx` runs through the real `RecordDetailView`. A probe inside the record page's own provider instance dispatches the action, and the test asserts the URL the runner hands to the view's `onNavigate`.

Each pin has two cases. With an active organization, the id resolves. With none, it resolves to an empty segment, never a literal `null`.

Reverse verification, each on the committed tree with `ablation-replace.mjs`, then restored with `git checkout HEAD` (blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty):

- Runtime pin, on `86e1966`: deleting `org: actionContextOrg(activeOrganization),` (blob `791d2a67a4e6` to `61295f1c5414`) turned it red, `Received: "/apps/cloud_control/sys_organization/record/"`.
- Record-page pin, on `04f6e70`: deleting `, org: actionContextOrg(activeOrganization)` from `RecordDetailView.tsx` (blob `eacded96409b` to `efe0920aa134`) turned it red, `Tests 1 failed | 1 passed (2)`, received `"/apps/cloud_control/sys_organization/record/"`.

Test runs at `44de8b6`:

- All 33 `RecordDetailView.*` test files: `Test Files 33 passed (33)`, `Tests 224 passed (224)`.
- The 15 runtime-adjacent files (`useConsoleActionRuntime*`, `DeclaredActionsBar*`, `PageView*`, `ConsoleShell*` tests): `Test Files 15 passed (15)`, `Tests 146 passed (146)`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check`, run after building the dependency closure (28/28 tasks): exit 0. `--listFilesOnly` on `tsconfig.test.json` lists both pins.

Gates at `44de8b6`, all exit 0:

- ESLint on the 5 touched source and test files: 0 errors. Warnings on `useConsoleActionRuntime.tsx` (37) and `RecordDetailView.tsx` (112) are identical per rule to `main` `7e8b3c0`. `actionContextOrg.ts` has none. The two pins have only no-explicit-any warnings in mock stubs (22 and 9).
- Changeset scripts: presence, no-major, overwrite, claims, fixed. `check-changeset-claims` notes that the pending `.changeset/7997-detail-view-related-retired.md` names `RecordDetailView.tsx`. Its paragraph is about the retired `DetailView` `related` member, which this change does not touch.
- `check:` gates: pending-changeset-literals, action-ref-convention, handler-key-reads, new-line-citations (0 new), control-bytes, vi-mock-specifiers, vi-mock-inherit, vi-mock-override-shape, test-path-roots, unreferenced-sources, metadata-write-doors, phantom-deps, self-import, esm-specifiers.
- Coverage scripts: check-type-check-coverage, check-lint-coverage.

Declared to CI: the full app-shell suite and repo-wide `pnpm lint`.

## Acceptance notes

- **`ActionRunner`'s `?? this.context.organization` fallback has no producer.** A `git grep` over objectui `packages/**` and `apps/**` found no source that sets `organization` on an action context. Now that the runtime supplies `org`, that fallback is a tolerant alias with zero pull. It is not changed here because `ActionRunner.ts` is held under objectui#10900.
- **The undeclared `activeOrganization` key still reaches authors.** `ActionProvider` copies every context key into the `ctx` interpolation scope, so `${ctx.activeOrganization.id}` resolves and predicates can read `ctx.activeOrganization`. Measured readers: `git grep -F "ctx.activeOrganization"` gives 0 in objectui (control `ctx.recordId`: 17), and 0 on cloud `origin/main` and objectstack `origin/main`. It is kept because this card adds a key and removes nothing. Retiring it is a separate decision. Carrier: none.
